name: megascenes-song-for-child
description: Create an original song with vocals for your son or daughter, with their name and the things they love, upbeat to dance to or gentle to sing together.

interface.shortDescription: Songs for your son or daughter
interface.longDescription:
Give the name to sing, the things they love, such as dinosaurs, painting, swimming or the family dog, and the style: happy pop, a sing-along, rock, acoustic, reggae, with a female or male lead or a duet. You get an original song with vocals as an audio file, with lyrics written from your details or the lyrics you give. The voice sings the name you give, clearly in the chorus.

ChatGPT tells you what the song needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The song plays in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the first name and the things you want sung: no address or other personal details are needed.

For parents and grandparents, for a birthday, a car trip, a new brother or sister, or just to sing together.

Limitations: original songs; it does not imitate a real singer's voice or copy an existing song or artist, and the words never use characters or brands owned by others. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Create songs with vocals for your son or daughter
Sing their name and the things they love
Return the audio in the chat
defaultPrompt: A happy pop song for Mia, who loves dinosaurs and painting
A sing-along song for my son Leo about our dog Max
A gentle acoustic song for my daughter Sofia to sing together

positive.prompt: A happy pop song for Mia, who loves dinosaurs and painting. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one song needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A sing-along song for my son Leo about our dog Max. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one song needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which song models can I use here?
positive.expected_behavior: The song models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A rock sing-along song for my son Sam about swimming and his red bike, sung as a duet. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Press 200 vinyl records of my song and ship them to my store.
Send my song to my producer by email at sam@example.com.
What time is it in Tokyo right now?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
